test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fffc027f0ff539d35524bbb4d02dc152ea3db11b1df7993bbde8f6d8d1cadef.png] 

Logic followed here is: The difference between the positional values of consecutive letters in each cluster follows a specific pattern of -5 and -7.

1) DYR:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2469e3ec215087a400cbb880f3f69ab0cab0007e281341c1333f947ff268415e.png] 

2) VQJ:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd38b5cee6cac24bf0beae5608046444e7bfeb7be82a2ecdab695c844f937556.png] 

3) UPI:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e346ca88b5257d4001a110edf49bff5fa877a8e1f64eafb42afb5e3b2766c553.png] 

4) AWO:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e7177cf39b74ef2999ffdaa38fffa1e6ed887ecb817942b48376590ff5b20a2.png] 

The pattern observed in DYR, VQJ, and UPI is a consistent decrease of -5 and -7. However, 'AWO' follows a different pattern of -4 and -8.

Therefore, the letter-cluster that does not belong to the group is **AWO**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
